integration_issues.issue: When clicked from UI, the frontend POSTs to=<admin_email> (admin@gov.sl). Resend free plan rejects with 422 because admin@gov.sl is not a verified address ('You can only send testing emails to your own email address (spyrateish@gmail.com)'). Backend forwards this error to UI which displays it in an error toast — so the expected success toast 'CSV emailed to admin@gov.sl (N rows)' / 'NRA-PAYE-Return-<period>.csv emailed to admin@gov.sl' NEVER fires from the UI in this environment. Backend pytest path explicitly uses delivered@resend.dev so backend tests pass. RECOMMENDATION: (a) Have frontend prefer delivered@resend.dev when REACT_APP_RESEND_TEST_MODE=true, OR (b) verify a real domain at resend.com/domains and change SENDER_EMAIL away from onboarding@resend.dev so any to: is allowed. Note: this limitation was called out in the review_request other_misc_info as expected.

rca of the issue: (1) Recharts width(-1): ResponsiveContainer measures its parent's clientWidth on first render; if the parent has display:flex with a not-yet-resolved width (common when chart sits inside a grid that animates in or is conditionally mounted), the initial measurement returns -1 / 0 and Recharts logs the warning before the next paint. Fix: ensure parent has explicit minWidth:0 (critical inside flex children) and either give ResponsiveContainer `aspect={N}` instead of height='100%' OR wrap in a measured div using ResizeObserver. (2) Email-CSV UI toast: frontend sends to: <current_user_email> by default. Resend free-tier sandbox only accepts the verified Resend account email (spyrateish@gmail.com) or sandbox delivered@resend.dev. Until a domain is verified at resend.com/domains, any UI click from admin@gov.sl will surface the 422 error in the toast. Backend pytest sidesteps this by sending to: delivered@resend.dev explicitly.
